summary.title: Serialize Tidepool uploads
changes: Tidepool uploads are now serialized so only one upload runs at a time.
Rapid triggers for the same upload type are coalesced so the same data is not uploaded twice.
Hung or lost upload calls now time out and are logged instead of silently stalling later uploads.
Tidepool upload log messages are corrected and are now labelled [Service] for clarity.
